relationships.subject: (+)-naltrexone precursors
relationships.evidence_quote: These precursors exhibited TLR4 antagonistic activities 100 times stronger than (+)-naltrexone

relationships.subject: (+)-naltrexone precursors
relationships.evidence_quote: by suppressing microglial activation and TNF-α expression in the medial prefrontal cortex and ventral tegmental area

key_findings: Precursors of (+)-naltrexone were about 100-fold more potent TLR4 antagonists than (+)-naltrexone, mainly inhibiting TLR4-TRIF signaling.
They reduced morphine sensitization and conditioned place preference with reduced microglial activation and TNF-α in mPFC and VTA.
